meta.title: Francisco Piñero Alpañés
meta.description: Francisco Piñero Alpañés. Digital transformation, interfaces, and applied AI. Based in Alicante.

identity.lead: Digital transformation developer. I am looking for a similar role, with more weight on interface design and UX, room to try new technology, and a team with a strong technical base.
identity.location: I live in Alicante (originally from Villena). Remote if the role is not in Alicante; hybrid if it is.

trajectory.title: Trajectory
trajectory.lead: Three stages. Choose one to see what I did and how it leads to what I want next.

consultora.heading: Web developer — Posiziona TI (Villena)
consultora.body: Management apps (Laravel and Vue), e-commerce (PrestaShop and WordPress), admin UI, databases, and Docker. BSc in Computer Engineering (University of Alicante, Software Engineering); final project Coffizine, interactive web form generation.

transformacion.heading: Digital Transformation Developer — Grupo Necomplus / ASEE
transformacion.body: Shipped generative-AI solutions (automation and conversational assistance), internal tools, corporate frontends, API integration, Azure, Docker, and CI/CD. Mostly remote, already based in Alicante.

ahora.heading: Next step
ahora.body: The same kind of problem (digital transformation and AI solutions), with more focus on interface and UX, experimentation, and an established team to learn with.

work.title: Work
work.lead: What changed for the people who used it. No clients, product names, or internal detail.

ai.title: Support that asks, instead of hunting
ai.body: Operations teams stopped jumping between tickets, wikis, and email. Conversational assistance over their own documentation: an interface to resolve work, not a generic chat.

vision.title: The first field review is done by the system
vision.body: When photographic evidence is required, the system says whether the capture is good enough and why. A person steps in when it fails.

queues.title: From a massive list to the next action
queues.body: Operations stopped deciding case by case on huge queues. An interface applies rules and suggests what to do; human review is left for what does not fit.

delivery.title: Internal products do not invent the path every time
delivery.body: Specify, implement, and ship to the cloud with the same interface standard. The value is team speed, not a one-off repository.

coffizine.title: Coffizine (final degree project)
coffizine.body: Interactive generation of web forms. A training project; the hook is UX, not a production product.

skills.title: Skills
skills.lead: A multidisciplinary technical profile, currently biased toward interface and UX. Stack I use day to day:
skills.also: Also: Vue, API integration, CI/CD, and ways of working with applied AI (not empty “AI” branding).
